history.summary: A 484sqft freehold shoebox 1BR right at Aljunied MRT (40m), built 2025, listed under a 'FIRE SALE' marketing title at $2,004 psf with no URA appreciation, txn count or median PSF in the dossier. The arena record is a losing 152-156-7 despite the high score_1000, and 40m from an above-ground MRT line typically means train noise.
history.rating_rationale: No verifiable URA data (no rate, no txn count, no median PSF) plus a clickbait 'FIRE SALE' title and a sub-.500 arena record (152-156) undercut the headline score_1000 of 734. A brand-new 2025 shoebox at $2,004 psf is developer/launch pricing, and 40m from the elevated EW line is a real noise liability that suppresses both rental quality and resale. Premium PSF on unverifiable data — pass.
red_flags: 40m from elevated MRT line — likely train noise
Losing arena record 152-156-7 despite high score
$2,004 psf on a brand-new shoebox — launch-inflated pricing
catalysts: Steps from Aljunied EW MRT — strong commuter tenant draw
